name: Heart Cage
source:
You are a detective who has just moved to a new town. You are involved in a serial killer case, and three mysterious residents (Or more?!) are approaching you!

Don't trust anyone! But... can you?

[From [url=https://rice-love-coffee.itch.io/heart-cage-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名刚搬到新镇的侦探。你卷入一桩连环杀人案，三位神秘居民（或者更多？！）正向你靠近！

别相信任何人！可是…你真能做到吗？

[摘自[url=https://rice-love-coffee.itch.io/heart-cage-demo]itch.io[/url]]
